{{for|the resident of the [[Two Rivers]]|Jori Congar}}
'''Jori''' is a [[Warder]] bonded to [[Morvrin Thakanos]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jori}}

== Appearance ==
He is quite short, even for a Cairhienin, and shorter than Morvrin.{{ref/book|10|16}} He is very wide, square-faced and bald.

==History==
He is considered to be one of the best swordsmen among the Warders.

== Activities ==
He is part of the Warders that accompany Egwene and Morvin when they survey the area around [[Tar Valon]]. {{ref/book|10|16}}

He is guarding [[Myrelle Berengari]]'s tent when [[Siuan Sanche]] arrives with the news that [[Egwene al'Vere]] is still alive inside the [[White Tower]].
